summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly open-market share repurchases under its previously announced buyback programme. The issuer bought 7,400 ordinary shares at an average price of approximately €23.67–€25.80 and 334,860 ADS-equivalent shares at roughly $28.24–$30.12 per ADS. These purchases are for cancellation, reducing share count. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed. The buyback continues under the 20 May 2025 programme, with EU regulatory disclosures. The risk-arb angle is minimal; the programme signals management's conviction in intrinsic value and capital returns policy.
